li.label: a night that ran late
li.description: We meant to go to bed hours before we did. Nobody wanted the night to end.

li.label: a slow morning
li.description: Too little sleep after a late night. Everything this morning takes twice as long.

li.label: sat up through the craving
li.description: I sat up all night with someone fighting a craving, and by morning it had eased. I'm worn out, and glad I did it.

li.label: someone sat up with me
li.description: The craving was bad last night. Someone sat with me until morning, and it's easier now.

HediffDef.label: a clean high
HediffDef.description: A high better than any they remember, with a clear head and no ache waiting for them in the morning.

HediffDef.label: a sharp mind
HediffDef.description: Their mind is quick and clear and their hands quicker. They pick things up fast and work well.

HediffDef.label: no fear
HediffDef.description: Nothing frightens them. Pain hardly reaches them, and their nerve holds where it wouldn't.

HediffDef.label: a high that turned
HediffDef.description: A wonderful high that turns, all at once, into a hard crash: heavy, slow and low.

HediffDef.label: a sudden craving
HediffDef.description: One taste and they want more of it, badly, for the rest of the day.

li.label: a clean high
li.description: That was the best I've ever had, and my head is clear as water.

li.label: a hard crash
li.description: It was wonderful, and now it's gone, and everything is grey and heavy.

li.label: a wonderful high
li.description: I feel better than I have in years.

li.label: a sudden craving
li.description: I only had the one, and now I can't stop thinking about another.

plain.li: [night] Nobody's going to bed yet, pour another.
[night] One more song, then bed, I promise.
[night] It's late, and I don't care, this is a good night.
[night,named] {GOD} is at the table tonight, nobody's going to bed.
[night,scoffer] We'll pay for this in the morning, but fine, one more.
[nightend] That's it, I'm going to bed, what a night.
[nightend] Is it really two already, where did the night go?
[morning] My head, and the sun's far too bright.
[morning] I've been up an hour and done nothing at all.
[morning,named] {GOD} always wants his share in the morning.
[vision] Wait, do you see that, out there?
[vision] Something's out there, I have to go and look.
[vision,named] {GOD} is showing me something, let me go.
[visiontrue] It was right here, just where I saw it.
[visiontrue] I knew it, I saw this before I came.
[visiontrue,named] {GOD} showed me true, look at it.
[visiontrue,scoffer] Well, I must have noticed it earlier without knowing.
[visionfalse] It was here, I saw it, I know I did.
[visionfalse] It's gone now, but it was here a moment ago.
[visionfalse,named] {GOD} showed me this place, there's something here.
[visionfalse,scoffer] Strong stuff, that, I'm going to sit down.
[cravingseen] {OTHER} is up in the stores at this hour, after {DRUG}.
[cravingseen] I saw {OTHER} creep out to the stores in the dark.
[cravingseen,named] {GOD} has {OTHER} by the throat tonight.
[cravingseen,scoffer] {OTHER} can't sleep without it, poor thing.
[stash] Someone hid {WHAT} out here, and never came back for it.
[stash] Look what was tucked in here, {WHAT}.
[stash,named] A gift from {GOD}, left right where I'd find it.
[stash,scoffer] Some traveller's stash, and finders keepers.
[binge] Another one, you and me, nobody else is drinking.
[binge] You'd say that, wouldn't you, pour me another.
[binge] Ha, that's a good one, tell it again.
[bingesaw] {OTHER} is laughing with an empty chair.
[bingesaw] Who is {OTHER} talking to, there's nobody there.
[bingesaw,named] {GOD} is sitting with {OTHER}, pouring for them.
[bingesaw,scoffer] {OTHER}'s drunk enough to see double, and then some.
[letgo] It'll pass, {OTHER}, I'm not going anywhere.
[letgo] Just till morning, {OTHER}, then it's easier.
[letgoeased] It's easier now, {OTHER}, thank you for staying.
[letgoeased] I made it through the night, {OTHER}, because you were here.
[letgoeased,named] {GOD} let go of me in the night, {OTHER}.
[letgoeased,scoffer] I'm through the worst of it, thanks to you, {OTHER}.
[satyrshare] Here, {OTHER}, this one's for you.
[satyrshare] Drink, {OTHER}, I poured it myself.
[satyrshare] You look thirsty, {OTHER}, take it.
[cupnotice] This {WHAT} smells sweeter than it should.
[cupnotice] One of these {WHAT} looks different, I can't say which.
[cupnotice,scoffer] This {WHAT} smells odd, someone should check the batch.
[cupclean] That's the best I've ever had, and my head is clear.
[cupclean,named] {GOD} poured that one for me, I'd swear it.
[cupsharp] I can see how everything fits together, let me work.
[cupsharp,scoffer] Good batch, my head's never been clearer.
[cupbold] Let them come, I'm not afraid of anything tonight.
[cupbold] I feel like I could walk through a wall.
[cuphigh] Oh, that's good, that is very good.
[cuphigh] I haven't felt this good in years.
[cupcrash] It's gone, all of it, and I feel terrible.
[cupcrash,named] {GOD} gave and now {GOD} takes, that's how he is.
[cupcrash,scoffer] Too much of a good thing, that's all.
[cupcraving] One more, I need one more of those.
[cupcraving] I only had the one, why do I want another so badly?
[cuphooked] I can't stop thinking about {DRUG}, after just one.
[cuphooked,named] {GOD} has his hook in me now.
[cuphooked,scoffer] One drink shouldn't do this to anyone.
